newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end slightly lower.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended slightly lower on Tuesday, while high-technology issues posted solid gains at the expense of financial shares.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 10.91 points to close at 8,187.54.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a margin of 16-12 on volume of about 528 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq Composite index, laden with technology shares, rose 16.08 to 1,621.53.
